title: Add comprehensive security restrictions for safe modding
body:
This commit implements a robust security model to prevent untrusted mod code from performing dangerous operations while still allowing safe GDScript modding.

Security Restrictions Implemented:

1. FILE SYSTEM SECURITY:
   - FileAccess: Blocked all write operations (store_*, resize, flush)
   - FileAccess: Restricted reads to user://mods/ directory only
   - FileAccess: Disabled file attribute modification
   - DirAccess: Completely disabled all directory operations
   - Added modding_security.h validation module

2. OS COMMAND SECURITY:
   - Disabled OS.execute(), create_process(), kill(), shell_open()
   - Blocked environment variable access (get/set_environment)
   - Prevented process spawning and manipulation

3. NETWORK SECURITY:
   - Disabled HTTPClient and HTTPRequest (all HTTP operations)
   - Disabled TCPServer, UDPServer, StreamPeerTCP
   - Disabled WebSocketPeer (WebSocket connections)
   - Complete network isolation for mod code

4. NATIVE CODE SECURITY:
   - Disabled GDExtensionManager.load_extension() and all variants
   - Prevents loading of native DLLs/shared libraries
   - Critical protection against arbitrary code execution

Modified Files:
- core/io/file_access.cpp - File access restrictions
- core/io/dir_access.cpp - Directory operations disabled
- core/core_bind.cpp - OS command restrictions
- core/io/http_client.cpp - HTTP disabled
- scene/main/http_request.cpp - HTTP request disabled
- core/io/tcp_server.cpp - TCP disabled
- core/io/udp_server.cpp - UDP disabled
- core/io/stream_peer_tcp.cpp - TCP streaming disabled
- modules/websocket/websocket_peer.cpp - WebSocket disabled
- core/extension/gdextension_manager.cpp - Native code loading disabled

New Files:
- core/io/modding_security.h - Security validation module
- MODDING_SECURITY.md - Complete security documentation

Attack Vectors Eliminated:
✓ File system manipulation
✓ Command injection
✓ Data exfiltration
✓ Malware execution
✓ Native code injection
✓ Network access
✓ Process spawning

Distribution Model:
- Distribute only compiled executable
- Modders use GDScript only
- All mods run in secure sandbox
- Files limited to user://mods/ directory for dependency reading

This fork is intended for distribution as a binary-only modding SDK where untrusted mod code needs to be safely sandboxed.
